_note: 英語島文法分區（最後一批）：推測確定度階梯（eng.t_adv.modal.probability-ladder，學測級）。肯定推斷 must（幾乎確定是）＞should/ought to（應該、預期）＞may/might/could（可能、不確定）；否定高確定推斷用 can't/couldn't（幾乎確定不是）。關鍵正確點：推斷的否定用 can't（不是 mustn't；mustn't＝禁止）。形式依 Swan/Cambridge，provisional，待英語母語 reviewer 複核。text-only shadowing、無音檔。

units.title_zh: 推測可能性階梯（must / should / may / might / could / can't）
units.can_do: 我能用情態助動詞表達對某事有多確定：幾乎確定是用 must，應該、預期用 should/ought to，可能但不確定用 may/might/could，幾乎確定不是用 can't/couldn't（不是 mustn't）。
units.subject: eng

claims.text: 'must' expresses a confident deduction: we are almost sure something is true because of the evidence. 'The lights are on, so someone must be home.'
claims.verification_ref: must 表示有把握的推斷（幾乎確定是）：someone must be home；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: 'may', 'might', and 'could' show that something is possible but we are not sure: 'She may/might/could be at home.'
claims.verification_ref: may/might/could＝可能但不確定（She might be at home）；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: For a confident negative deduction (we are almost sure something is NOT true) we use 'can't' or 'couldn't', NOT 'mustn't': 'He can't be hungry; he has just eaten.' ('mustn't' means it is not allowed.)
claims.verification_ref: 推斷的否定用 can't/couldn't（He can't be hungry），不用 mustn't（mustn't＝禁止）；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: 'should' and 'ought to' express a weaker expectation: we expect something because it is likely or normal. 'They left early, so they should be here by now.'
claims.verification_ref: should/ought to＝預期、應該（they should be here by now）；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: Modal verbs show how sure we are. When we are almost certain something is true, we use 'must': 'The lights are on, so someone must be home.'
teach.zh_hint: 情態助動詞可以表示「我們有多確定」。幾乎確定「是」的時候用 must：The lights are on, so someone must be home.（燈開著，一定有人在家。）

teach.body: When something is only possible and we are not sure, use 'may', 'might', or 'could': 'She may be at home, but I'm not sure.'
teach.zh_hint: 只是「可能」、沒把握的時候，用 may、might 或 could：She may be at home, but I'm not sure.（她可能在家，但我不確定。）確定度比 must 低。

teach.body: Important: for a confident NEGATIVE deduction (we are almost sure something is NOT true), use 'can't' or 'couldn't' — NOT 'mustn't'. 'He can't be hungry; he has just eaten.' ('mustn't' means 'not allowed'.)
teach.zh_hint: 重要：要說「幾乎確定不是」這種否定推斷，用 can't 或 couldn't，不用 mustn't。He can't be hungry; he has just eaten.（他不可能餓，他剛吃過。）mustn't 的意思是「禁止」，不是推斷。

teach.body: 'should' and 'ought to' are a bit weaker: we expect something because it is likely. 'They left an hour ago, so they should be there by now.'
teach.zh_hint: should 和 ought to 語氣稍弱：因為「照理說」而預期某事。They left an hour ago, so they should be there by now.（他們一小時前就出發了，照理說現在該到了。）

teach.body: That must be John's car. It might rain later. This can't be the right answer.
teach.zh_hint: 那一定是 John 的車（must＝幾乎確定）。等一下可能會下雨（might＝可能）。這不可能是正確答案（can't＝幾乎確定不是）。

practice.stem: 選正確的推斷（我們幾乎確定「是」）：The lights are on, so someone ____ be home.

distractor_rationales.can't: can't 表示「幾乎確定不是」，與「有人在家」的推斷相反。
distractor_rationales.might not: might not 表示「可能不是」，但這裡有強證據（燈亮著），應該用更確定的 must。
distractor_rationales.needn't: needn't 表示「不必」，不是對事實的推斷。

practice.feedback: 有力證據＋幾乎確定「是」＝must：someone must be home。

practice.stem: 選正確的推斷（我們幾乎確定「不是」）：He has just eaten a big meal, so he ____ be hungry.

distractor_rationales.must: must be hungry 表示「一定餓」，與剛吃飽的證據矛盾。
distractor_rationales.should: should 表示「應該、預期」，語氣不夠強，也方向相反。
distractor_rationales.may: may be hungry 表示「可能餓」，但剛吃飽讓我們幾乎確定「不餓」，要用 can't。

practice.feedback: 推斷的否定（幾乎確定不是）用 can't：he can't be hungry。

practice.stem: 選正確的推斷（可能、但不確定）：I'm not sure where she is. She ____ be at the library.

distractor_rationales.must: must 表示「幾乎確定」，但句子說 I'm not sure，矛盾。
distractor_rationales.can't: can't 表示「幾乎確定不是」，與「可能在圖書館」相反。
distractor_rationales.will: will 雖可表達有把握的推斷（如 That'll be the postman＝那應該是郵差），但這裡說 I'm not sure（不確定），用 will 語氣太過確定、互相矛盾；只是可能、沒把握要用 might。

practice.feedback: 不確定、只是可能＝may/might/could：She might be at the library。

practice.stem: 選正確的推斷（照理說、預期）：They left an hour ago, so they ____ be there by now.

distractor_rationales.can't: can't 表示「幾乎確定不是」，與「照理說該到了」相反。
distractor_rationales.might not: might not 表示「可能沒到」，但有時間證據，用 should 表達合理預期更貼切。
distractor_rationales.couldn't: couldn't 表示「不可能」，方向相反。

practice.feedback: 照理說、合理預期＝should/ought to：they should be there by now。

practice.stem: 我們幾乎確定 Tom 不是小偷。哪一句正確？
options: Tom doesn't must be the thief.
Tom may not be the thief.

mustn't 的意思是「禁止」，不能用來做否定推斷；推斷的否定要用 can't。
must 是情態助動詞，不能跟 do/does 連用，文法錯誤。
may not 只是「可能不是」，語氣不夠確定；題目說「幾乎確定不是」，要用 can't。

practice.feedback: 推斷「幾乎確定不是」用 can't，不用 mustn't（mustn't＝禁止）：Tom can't be the thief。

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案自己判斷（不自動判讀）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 朗讀練習（不產音檔、不自動判讀）：出聲讀句子，一邊讀一邊想「這句有多確定」；注意 must be、can't be、might be 的語氣差別。

lines.text: That must be John's car; nobody else has a red one.
He can't be hungry, because he has just eaten a big lunch.
